weapons.name: T3x Arctic Bolt-action
weapons.source_note: Tikka T1x/T3x Instruction Manual v5.3, table 'Caliber / Rate of twist [in] / Number of grooves': "308 Win..........................11". . 4". States a 1 turn in 11 inch right-hand twist = 279.4 mm per turn with 4 grooves for the .308 Win (7.62x51mm NATO) barrel used by the T3x line, which includes the Arctic. The model-specific Tikka 'ARCTIC_technical_specifications.pdf' sheet gives the same rate: "CALIBER / RATE OF TWIST ... 308 Win / 11"".

weapons.name: T3x Compact 7mm-08 Bolt-action
weapons.source_note: Tikka T1x/T3x Instruction Manual v5.3, table 'Caliber / Rate of twist [in] / Number of grooves': "7mm-08 Rem............9.5". . 4". States a 1 turn in 9.5 inch right-hand twist = 241.3 mm per turn with 4 grooves for 7mm-08 Remington. Tikka's own T3x Compact product data (choose.tikka.fi model feed) gives the same 1:9.5" for 7MM-08 REM.

weapons.name: T3x UPR .308 Bolt-action
weapons.source_note: Tikka T3x UPR product page, variant table row 'Caliber = 308 Win.' paired with row 'Rate of twist = 1:10"'. States a 1 turn in 10 inch twist = 254.0 mm per turn. Tikka's own T3x UPR product feed also lists "308WIN ... 1:10"". Note: the generic T3x instruction manual lists .308 Win as 11" for the standard T3x barrels; the UPR is specified at 1:10" by the model-specific Tikka data.

weapons.name: SV-98 Sniper Rifle
weapons.source_note: Kalashnikov Concern SV-98 catalogue page, technical data: "Twist rate 320" and "Number of grooves 4". States 320 mm per turn (about 1 turn in 12.6 inches) with 4 grooves. The same page gives the barrel as 650 mm and the cartridge as 7.62x54R, not 7.62x51mm NATO as recorded in the worklist.

weapons.name: AS Val Assault Rifle
weapons.source_note: Small Arms Defense Journal (V11N6), AS Val article: "As the weapon is integrally suppressed, the barrel extends to 12cm long; the porting consists of six rows of nine holes spiraling along the rifling grooves. The twist rate is 1:8.3 inches." States a 1 turn in 8.3 inch twist = 210.8 mm per turn. The article also notes the AS Val was designed at TsNIITochMash and produced at the Tula Arms Plant.

weapons.name: M1 Carbine Carbine
weapons.source_note: Inland Manufacturing (current maker of the M1 Carbine to the original specification) product specifications: "Barrel groove: 4 Twist rate: 1 x 20"". States a 1 turn in 20 inch twist = 508.0 mm per turn with 4 grooves. Source is the manufacturer's data sheet for the M1 Carbine; the original Second World War M1 Carbine used the same .30 Carbine barrel specification.

weapons.name: M07 Sniper Rifle
weapons.source_note: Zastava Arms Sniper Rifle M07 page, 'Technical characteristics' table, reading across the columns: "Caliber (mm) 7.62x51 | Twist rate (mm) 254 | Number of grooves 6". States a 254 mm per turn (1 turn in 10 inches) twist with 6 grooves for the 7.62x51 mm chambering. The related M07 AS and M07 M pages give the same 254 mm / 6 grooves for 7.62x51 mm.
